audience: WordPress site owners and agencies who host their sites on Kinsta

useCases.title: List our sites with status and environments
useCases.text: Lists the WordPress sites with status and labels, and the live and staging environments with domain, PHP version and WordPress version.

useCases.title: Check traffic and usage of a site
useCases.text: Gets this month's visits and bandwidth of a site, and analytics of an environment, such as top countries, referrers, response codes and disk space.

useCases.title: Find plugins and themes that need an update
useCases.text: Lists the plugins and themes of an environment with version, available update version and vulnerability flags.

useCases.title: Read error, access or cache performance logs
useCases.text: Reads recent lines of the error log, access log or cache performance log, within a time range or filtered by a search text.

useCases.title: Review domains, redirects, blocked IPs and HTTPS
useCases.text: Lists an environment's domains and redirect rules, the IPs blocked from it, and whether HTTPS is forced.

useCases.title: Clear a cache, restart PHP or create a backup
useCases.text: Clears the page or edge cache of an environment, restarts its PHP engine, or starts a manual backup with a note. Each returns an operation id to check.
